title: Cannot access payroll portal after MFA reset
body: I reset my MFA this morning and now the payroll portal rejects every code. Payroll closes today and I cannot submit approvals.
business_impact: Manager cannot approve payroll before deadline.

title: Laptop battery is swelling
body: The laptop case is bulging near the trackpad and it gets hot even when idle. I stopped using it and need a replacement device.

title: VPN connects but internal sites time out
body: VPN authentication succeeds, but intranet, Git, and ticketing all time out from home Wi-Fi. Other internet sites work.

title: Suspicious attachment received from fake vendor
body: I received an invoice attachment from a vendor address that looks misspelled. I did not open it. Please check whether this is phishing.

title: Outlook calendar invites are not syncing
body: Calendar invites sent from my phone do not appear in desktop Outlook. Email works normally and this started after yesterday's update.

title: CRM export button returns an error
body: When I export account records from the CRM, the page shows error 500. My teammate can export the same account list.

title: Need Python package installed
body: The data analysis tool fails because package openpyxl is missing. I can keep working with CSVs today, but XLSX import is needed this week.

title: Need help choosing the right form
body: Which form should I use to request a new shared mailbox for a temporary project?
